visual_elements.description: Vertical neural-network data-flow diagram, read bottom-to-top. (1) Bottom: dark-blue rectangle labeled 'Last Decoder Block' (white bold text). (2) Four green up-arrows rise from this bar to 4 solid green circles. (3) These circles sit inside a light-green rectangle (green border) labeled 'Linear Projection' (green bold text, right side); the box also contains a row of 16 solid magenta circles above the green circles; every green circle connects to every magenta circle with thin straight blue lines (4x16 = 64 lines, fully-connected bipartite, no arrowheads). (4) Sixteen red up-arrows rise from the top edge of the green box to the dark-red 'Softmax' bar (white bold text). (5) Sixteen blue up-arrows rise from the Softmax bar to a row of 16 pale-blue circles with thin blue-gray outlines (empty/unfilled nodes = vocabulary logits/probabilities). (6) A red curly brace arches over the 16 pale circles, apex pointing up toward the subtitle 'Probability of each word in Vocab'. Red 'Vocab Size' labels appear at left of the pale-circle row and at left of the magenta-circle row, indicating both rows have vocabulary-sized dimension.
